create_concat_dataset_from_configs: create a concatenated dataset from Hydra DictConfig objects with balanced or explicit sampling ratios
build_concat_dataset_with_sampling: build a ConcatDataset from a dict of datasets using explicit balanced temperature or weighted sampling strategies
get_dataset_sample_index: get the owning dataset index and internal sample index for a given concatenated sample index
compute_cumulative_sizes: compute cumulative sizes across multiple datasets weighted by their sample ratios
get_metadata_for_samples: get natoms metadata for a list of sample indices across multiple concatenated datasets
